questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "risk‑off selling" mean?
options: Investors are holding onto their stocks
questions.explain_en: "Risk‑off selling" means investors are selling assets they consider risky because they want to avoid risk.
questions.explain_zh: 「risk‑off selling」指的是投資人因為想降低風險而拋售他們認為有風險的資產。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX tumbles 2.5% Friday as foreign funds flee

questions.question: By how many points did the TAIEX drop on Friday?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the TAIEX fell by 1,156.5 points, which is a 2.49% decline.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明台股指數下跌了 1,156.5 點，跌幅為 2.49%。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX tumbles 2.5% Friday as foreign funds flee

questions.question: How much AI server revenue has Foxconn reported for the first three quarters?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that AI server revenue has already exceeded NT$1 trillion through the first three quarters.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，前九個月的 AI 伺服器營收已超過新台幣 1 兆。
questions.news_title_en: Foxconn's AI server revenue tops NT$1 trillion in first nine months

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "resilience" mean?
options: the amount of money a bank holds
the speed of a computer network
the ability to recover quickly from difficulties
the number of customers a bank has
questions.explain_en: Here "resilience" refers to the ability to withstand and recover from cyber attacks.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「resilience」指的是在面對網路攻擊時能夠快速恢復的能力。
questions.news_title_en: FSC sets 2026 exam focus on fraud, AML and cyber-resilience

questions.question: How many inspection points are included in the FSC's 2026 examination priorities?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the four priority areas cover a combined 113 inspection points.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，四個重點領域合計有 113 個檢查點。
questions.news_title_en: FSC sets 2026 exam focus on fraud, AML and cyber-resilience

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "succession" mean?
options: Passing assets to the next generation
questions.explain_en: Here "succession" refers to planning for who will inherit or manage assets after the current owner dies.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「succession」指的是資產在所有者過世後的繼承或管理規劃。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth pool keeps expanding into 2026, KPMG says

questions.question: According to the KPMG report, what percentage of high‑net‑worth residents already hold offshore assets?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that roughly 74% of those residents already hold offshore assets.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明約有 74% 的高淨值居民已持有離岸資產。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan's high-net-worth pool keeps expanding into 2026, KPMG says

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "folded back into" mean?
questions.explain_en: It means the gifted assets are counted again as part of the taxable estate.
questions.explain_zh: 「folded back into」指的是把贈與的資產重新算入應稅遺產中。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan tightens estate-tax rules on gifts made before death

questions.question: According to the summary, who becomes liable for the estate tax on gifts made within two years before death?
options: The original owner of the asset
questions.explain_en: The summary states that the recipient now has to pay the related estate tax.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要說明，收到贈與的人現在需要負擔相關的遺產稅。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan tightens estate-tax rules on gifts made before death

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "buoyed" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Buoyed" means that something was supported or helped, in this case AI-driven exports and private investment helped the economy.
questions.explain_zh: 「buoyed」指受到支撐或提升，這裡是說 AI 相關的出口與民間投資讓經濟得到幫助。
questions.news_title_en: Central bank holds rates again, lifts 2026 growth forecast

questions.question: How many consecutive quarters has Taiwan's central bank kept policy rates unchanged?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the hold has been extended to ten straight quarters.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明政策利率已連續保持十個季度不變。
questions.news_title_en: Central bank holds rates again, lifts 2026 growth forecast
